name: Elsevier (single/1.5/double)
notes: Elsevier defines three widths; 'double' is used when default_columns >= 2. The 1.5-column width (140 mm) is recorded but not selected automatically because it is figure-specific - pass meta.canvas.w_mm to use it.
source: Elsevier artwork and media instructions (https://www.elsevier.com/researcher/author/policies-and-guidelines/artwork-and-media-instructions): single column 90 mm, 1.5 column 140 mm, double column 190 mm, minimum 7 pt type for labels. Widths from the guideline; pt/margins/height are working values (see param_source).

dpi.detail: >=300 dpi for raster, >=1000 dpi for line art

font_sizes_pt.detail: working sizes at/above Elsevier's 7 pt minimum, clamped to contract floors
